**Do not report bugs or feature requests here!**

This project is a fork of Mozilla's pdf.js. Bug reports are welcome - just not here:
- If you've found a bug or if you have a feature request related to ngx-extended-pdf-viewer, please report it at [https://github.com/stephanrauh/ngx-extended-pdf-viewer/issues](https://github.com/stephanrauh/ngx-extended-pdf-viewer/issues).
- If you've found a bug in the PDF viewer of Firefox or Mozilla's pdf.js library, go to their bug tracker: [https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/issues](https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/issues).
